description_en: Queries whether a phone number supports card SMS messages
description_zh: 查询手机号是否支持卡片短信
kebab_example: aliyun dysmsapi query-mobiles-card-support --template-code CARD_SMS_20000 --mobiles example-string --encrypt-type NORMAL --api-version 2017-05-25 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryMobilesCardSupport

parameters.description_en:
The code of the card SMS template. To view the code, log on to the console and choose **Domestic Messages** > [Template Management](https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/template).

>The template must be added and approved.
parameters.description_zh:
卡片短信模板Code。请在控制台选择**国内消息**>[模板管理](https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/template)页面查看。

>必须是已添加、并通过审核的卡片短信模板。

parameters.description_en:
The encryption method for the phone number. Valid values:
- SHA1: SHA1 encryption.
- NORMAL: no encryption. The phone number is transmitted in plaintext.
parameters.description_zh:
手机号码加密方式。取值：
- SHA1：SHA1加密方式。
- NORMAL：不加密，明文传输。
